subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should unconfigured memorySearch.sync.intervalMinutes become a non-zero default fallback, or should periodic memory sync remain opt-in with docs/doctor guidance?
rationale: The bug is real, but changing a shipped default can add background filesystem scans and provider/indexing work for existing users, which is a product and compatibility choice rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept default fallback after repair
options.body: Merge the linked fix once the interval dirty marking is scoped correctly and upgrade behavior is documented and accepted.

options.title: Keep fallback opt-in
options.body: Leave the default at 0, document intervalMinutes as the workaround, and consider a doctor recommendation instead of changing runtime defaults.

options.title: Request another design
options.body: Ask for a watcher health/doctor recovery design if maintainers do not want either default-on periodic sync or opt-in-only guidance.

recommendation.title: Accept default fallback after repair
recommendation.body: Merge the linked fix once the interval dirty marking is scoped correctly and upgrade behavior is documented and accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the original memory search feature and subsequent memory engine ownership boundaries.
